title: Lease terms and changes
summary: This topic mainly groups fragmented mentions of lease terms, changed settings, and model comparisons, with too little coherent sentiment evidence to form a single clear customer view.

positive.summary: One review positively mentions being happy after making a change.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention lease-end decisions, contract mismatches, changed features, and unrelated service or animation notes without enough context for reliable sentiment labeling.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and too short or incomplete to support confident sentiment interpretation.
The cluster mixes several loosely related subjects, including lease contracts, product changes, service setup, charging pad behavior, and animation comments.
Examples are insufficient to determine a single dominant issue beyond broad mentions of changes and lease-related terms.
